description:
£135 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to bring this three bedroom student property to the rental market.

Situated on Springbank Road in the popular area of Sandyford, this first-floor, end of terrace flat offers spacious accommodation in a convenient location, making it an excellent choice for students.

The property comprises an entrance hallway, three generously sized double bedrooms, a large living area, a fitted kitchen and a bathroom. The spacious layout provides plenty of room for comfortable student living and socialising with housemates.

Ideally positioned close to Newcastle city centre, the property offers easy access to both Northumbria University and Newcastle University, as well as the shops, restaurants and amenities the city has to offer.

Combining spacious accommodation with a fantastic location, this property is well worth viewing.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our dedicated Lettings Team!
